rows.target_brief: Full main road cross-section between the fixed A and B endpoints through the paved connection between the buildings.
rows.notes: Original, guide and a native-pixel target crop inspected, including both terminals. Scattered boards and fragments are visible on the paved connection. The north side merges into an unseparated parking/frontage area with wheel stops; a complete main-road boundary cannot be established without inventing a division through that forecourt.
uncertainties: The full main-road cross-section is not separable from the adjoining unmarked parking/frontage pavement.

rows.target_brief: Full curved main road cross-section from fixed A at the western access to fixed B beside the southeast building corner.
rows.notes: Original, guide and three overlapping native-pixel crops inspected over the complete fixed route, both ends and both sides. Numerous detached items are visible on the pavement. The east boundary at B is obscured by tree crowns and overlapping debris, and parts of the route join an unmarked frontage/parking expanse. A full road polygon cannot be traced reliably.
uncertainties: Tree crowns and debris obscure the road edge near fixed B.
The main-road edge is not consistently separable from the adjoining unmarked frontage.

rows.target_brief: Full main road cross-section over the complete route between the fixed A and B endpoints.
rows.notes: Original, guide and three overlapping native-pixel strips inspected along the entire fixed segment and both terminal cross-sections. Most pavement is unobstructed in the view. Branch crowns obscure stretches of the southern road edge near the western half; their shadows are not treated as entities. A complete boundary cannot be traced beneath the crowns.
uncertainties: The southern road boundary and any small edge intrusions are hidden beneath tree crowns in the western half.

rows.target_brief: Full main road cross-section over the complete route between the fixed A and B endpoints.
rows.notes: Original, guide and four overlapping native-pixel crops inspected along the complete fixed route, both terminals and both sides. Detached white structural fragments extend onto paved areas beside the homes. Parked cars are visible along the southeast side; their presence alone is not an obstacle finding. Debris, a palm crown and adjoining parking pavement prevent a reliable complete main-road boundary.
uncertainties: The southeast main-road edge is obscured by debris and a crown near the parked black car.
The boundary between the travel corridor and adjoining parking/frontage pavement is not consistently identifiable.
